Your provider will take time to review your health history and goals with you — in English or Spanish, whichever you prefer.

primaryCare.title: Everyday care that grows with you
primaryCare.intro: Your primary care team is your first point of contact for staying healthy and managing concerns as they arise. We focus on prevention, early detection, and a long-term partnership in your care.
features: Chronic disease management (such as diabetes, hypertension, and cholesterol)
Sick visits for acute, non-emergency concerns
Coordination of referrals and specialist care
primaryCare.expectBody: At your visit, your provider reviews your history, listens to your concerns, and works with you on a plan tailored to your needs. We take the time to answer your questions in the language you are most comfortable with.

labs.title: Clear answers start with the right tests
labs.intro: Lab work helps your provider understand your health, catch issues early, and track how a treatment plan is working. We make testing convenient with in-office collection and trusted laboratory partners.
features: In-office blood draw with a partner laboratory
labs.processBody: Your provider determines which tests are appropriate based on your evaluation. Samples are collected in-office and processed by our laboratory partner. Results are reviewed with you so you understand what they mean for your care. Testing recommendations are individualized — this page does not guarantee specific tests or results.

weightManagement.title: Medically supervised weight management
weightManagement.intro: Our weight-management program combines clinical oversight with practical lifestyle support. Care is individualized and begins with a provider evaluation to determine whether the program is appropriate for you.
features: A clinical evaluation of your health history and goals
A discussion of treatment options when clinically appropriate
weightManagement.eligibilityBody: Eligibility is determined by a licensed provider based on your individual health profile. The program is not a one-size-fits-all plan, and we do not promise specific outcomes. Your provider will discuss what to expect and any options that may be appropriate for you.

glp1.title: Medically supervised GLP-1 treatment
glp1.intro: GLP-1 medications may be offered as one part of a comprehensive, medically supervised weight-management plan. They are prescription medications used only after a clinical evaluation and prescribed at the discretion of a licensed provider.
glp1.featuresHeading: How GLP-1 care works with us
features: A clinical evaluation to review your health history and goals
A provider determination of whether treatment is appropriate for you
Integration with lifestyle and nutrition support
Ongoing monitoring and follow-up while in the program
glp1.howBody: GLP-1 medications are prescription medications dispensed only after a clinical evaluation. Eligibility is determined by a licensed provider, and treatment is not guaranteed. Your provider will discuss whether GLP-1 therapy fits your individual plan.
glp1.safetyBody: Like all medications, GLP-1 treatments can have side effects, which may include nausea and digestive discomfort, among others. Your provider will review the potential benefits and risks with you. Always talk to your provider before starting, changing, or stopping any medication.
glp1.fdaNote: We will discuss the specific medication that may be appropriate for you, including its regulatory status, during your evaluation. This page makes no claims about specific brands or FDA-approval status.

privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Sanos Medical Group ("we", "us") collects and uses information through this website. It applies to this website only and is separate from our HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices, which governs protected health information.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: When you submit the appointment-request form, we collect the contact information you provide: your name, email, phone, preferred contact method, preferred time window, and a non-medical reason for your visit. Please do not submit medical details through this website.

sections.heading: How we use information
sections.body: We use this information only to respond to your request, schedule and confirm appointments, and contact you about your inquiry.

sections.heading: How information is stored and shared
sections.body: Submissions are stored in our secure database and may be shared with our scheduling team and the service providers that help us operate this website (for example, our hosting, database, and spreadsheet providers). We do not sell your personal information. [Confirm vendors — TODO.]

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: This website uses only essential cookies by default. If analytics or other non-essential cookies are added, we will request your consent first. [Update if analytics are added — TODO.]

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: You may contact us to ask about, update, or request deletion of the information you submitted, subject to applicable law and our record-keeping obligations.

sections.heading: Children's privacy
sections.body: This website is not directed to children, and we do not knowingly collect information from children through it.

sections.heading: Changes and contact
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. If you have questions, contact us at [contact — TODO].

hipaa.intro: THIS NOTICE DESCRIBES HOW MEDICAL INFORMATION ABOUT YOU MAY BE USED AND DISCLOSED AND HOW YOU CAN GET ACCESS TO THIS INFORMATION. PLEASE REVIEW IT CAREFULLY. [Placeholder — must be completed and reviewed by counsel.]

sections.heading: Our duties
sections.body: We are required by law to maintain the privacy of your protected health information (PHI), to provide you this Notice of our legal duties and privacy practices, and to follow the terms of the Notice currently in effect.

sections.heading: How we may use and disclose your health information
sections.body: We may use and disclose your PHI for treatment, payment, and health care operations, and as otherwise permitted or required by law. [Detail — TODO.]

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to inspect and copy your PHI, request amendments, request restrictions, request confidential communications, receive an accounting of certain disclosures, and obtain a paper copy of this Notice. [Detail — TODO.]

sections.heading: Complaints

sections.heading: Contact and effective date

accessibility.intro: Sanos Medical Group is committed to making this website accessible to everyone, including people with disabilities.

sections.heading: Our commitment
sections.body: We aim to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA and to follow accessible design practices such as semantic structure, keyboard navigation, visible focus indicators, descriptive alternative text, and sufficient color contrast.

sections.heading: Ongoing effort
sections.body: Accessibility is an ongoing effort, and we continue to improve the site. [Confirm audit status before launch — TODO.]

sections.heading: Feedback and contact
sections.body: If you encounter an accessibility barrier or need assistance, please contact us at [contact — TODO] and we will work to provide the information or service you need.

sections.heading: Alternative access
sections.body: We are glad to assist by phone with anything you are unable to access on the website.

medicalDisclaimer.intro: The information on this website is provided for general educational and informational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

sections.heading: Not medical advice
sections.body: Content on this website does not constitute medical advice and should not be relied upon for medical decisions. Always seek the advice of your physician or another qualified health provider with any questions about a medical condition.

sections.heading: No doctor–patient relationship
sections.body: Viewing this website or contacting us through it does not establish a doctor–patient relationship. That relationship begins only after an established clinical evaluation.

sections.heading: Individual results vary
sections.body: Descriptions of services, including weight management and GLP-1 therapy, are general. Treatment requires evaluation by a licensed provider, eligibility is determined individually, and results vary. We make no guarantees of specific outcomes.

sections.heading: Medications
sections.body: Prescription medications, including GLP-1 medications, are provided only after a clinical evaluation and at the discretion of a licensed provider. Talk to your provider about the benefits and risks.

sections.heading: Emergencies
sections.body: Do not use this website for medical emergencies. If you have a medical emergency, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room immediately.
